description: A jQuery plugin named Readmore.js that provides functionality to truncate and expand content sections with 'Read More' and 'Close' links, including CSS embedding, toggle animations, and resize handling.

classes.name: Readmore
classes.description: Main class implementing the readmore functionality, including initialization, toggle, resize, and destroy methods.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up the content sections, and binds resize event.

methods.name: toggleSlider
methods.description: Handles the toggle between expanded and collapsed states with animation and callbacks.

methods.name: setBoxHeight
methods.description: Calculates and stores the expanded height of the content section.

methods.name: resizeBoxes
methods.description: Resizes all sections based on current content height, used on window resize.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes plugin classes, styles, event handlers, and data from the element.
